Printed edition: Plutarch's Lives, Selected and Edited by John S. White, New York, G.P. Putnam <C1883>, 1883, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/plutarchslives0000unse_w1a4. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 80%, 93%, 93% of their four-word runs in the scan's text.
